title: Long rainbow arithmetic progressions
exact_target: Does the number of equal-size color classes needed to force a long rainbow arithmetic progression grow quadratically with its length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3038 (OPG-426). CC BY 4.0.

Jesse Geneson, \emph{The order of long rainbow arithmetic progressions}, arXiv:2607.15116 (2026), §1 and Theorem 1. Theorem 1 gives $T_k=\Theta(k^2\log k)$, refuting the recorded quadratic-order conjecture.
